title: AIO
features:
Mobile Optimized UI (Rounded, Draggable, Toggle Button)

Aim Lock

Infinite Health & Stamina (God Mode)

No Stun (Anti-Ragdoll / Anti-Slow)

Auto Equip '1' (Strict One-Time Press)

Auto Attack (Remote Event Damage Spam)

Auto Click (Physical Mouse Click / Animation Spam)

Auto Slam (Auto G Key)

Smart Weave (Auto Dodge)

Smart Counter Logic (2x Weave into 5s Punish Mode)

Pathfinding Auto Follow (Smart Navigation)

Chase Speed Boost (WalkSpeed 25 when following)

Manual Movement Override (Stops following when you move)

Sticky Targeting

Range Slider

Keybind Support (Left Ctrl for Menu, '1' for Attack Toggle)

comments.text:
The script makes you auto-attack whenever you press 1 to equip your fists. Infinite stamina and infinite health don’t work.

It’d be awesome to have a separate, more lowkey script that adds no stun, no slowdown, and infinite staminamaybe even a kill hitboxso players can use it without being too obvious.
